posts.name: Heybrain
posts.tagline: The governed AI brain for people and agents.
posts.description: HeyBrain is your company's shared AI brain for people and agents. Your knowledge is scattered across Slack, Notion, Drive, GitHub and the rest of your stack. Brain connects it into one governed place where your team and your AI agents ask questions and get answers from only what they're allowed to see — same context, same permissions, every access written to a tamper-evident, content-blind log. One company brain: always on, permission-aware, and built for how teams actually use AI.

posts.name: Claude Opus 5.5

posts.description: Claude Opus 5.5 leads in agentic coding and knowledge work, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

posts.name: RealPost Pro
posts.tagline: AI property photos & motion for estate agents
posts.description: RealPost Pro turns the property photos you already have into polished listing visuals. AI photo enhancement balances light and clarity while keeping proportions true; AI motion clips turn stills into short cinematic walk-throughs. Built for estate agents who want a better first impression with less admin. Local previews are free; sign in to save your own photos. Originals stay intact.

posts.name: Date with Jev
posts.tagline: Paste your date’s chat and get a brutal read on red flags.
posts.description: Paste a dating chat and Jev calls it: green flag, yellow flag, or red flag. Love bombing, flakiness, scam risk, and manipulation, each scored, in one private, shareable read.

posts.name: NudgeLink
posts.tagline: AI SDR that finds, scores, and messages LinkedIn leads
posts.description: NudgeLink is an AI SDR for LinkedIn outreach. Describe your business and ideal customer, and it finds relevant profiles, scores every lead against your ICP, explains the match, and writes personalized messages in your voice. Review the reasoning and stay in control before anything is sent. Start with 1,000 free credits - no card required, and they never expire.

posts.name: Flic
posts.tagline: Flic was #1 here at launch, back w/ on device AI Superpowers
posts.description: Flic invented swipe-to-clean in 2014, and launched #1 on Product Hunt. Now it's rebuilt from scratch with on-device AI: swipe to keep, delete, favorite or share, while AI finds duplicates, blurry shots and your daily Best 25. Your photos never leave your iPhone. The OG, category creator back with a product that is 10x and priced for mass adoption.

posts.name: RealGoals
posts.tagline: Goal scheduling that spots burnout before you do
posts.description: Meet Pace, your personal AI scheduler. A new goal or the routine you already keep: Pace holds it on your calendar, adjusts week by week to what actually happened, and helps prevent burnout before you notice it

posts.name: MeloQA
posts.tagline: Test management with automation and project integrations
posts.description: MeloQA is an all-in-one QA management platform covering the full testing lifecycle: test case management, test cycles, manual execution, bug tracking, and reporting dashboards. It integrates natively with Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, and Businessmap, plus a public API for custom workflows. MeloAI adds AI-powered test case generation from user stories or recorded flows, and automated test script creation, helping QA teams cut manual work and keep full requirement traceability.

posts.name: HannahDream
posts.tagline: Your AI Girlfriend for Romantic Chat, Roleplay & Photos
posts.description: Meet Hannah for romantic chat, relationship memory, and safe personalized photos. Start with three live anonymous replies, then continue privately with an account.

posts.name: DENZIN - AI Playtest Researcher
posts.tagline: Ship better player experiences with faster feedback loops
posts.description: Denzin builds a playtest around your problem statement, triangulates every session into one clear picture, and hands back a decision-grade report. Every insight cited to a player quote and the exact timestamp. Ship better player experiences, with end-to-end player research, at a fraction of the cost.

posts.name: ArcLab
posts.tagline: Stop building tools. Start building systems.
posts.description: ArcLab takes you from idea to a verified, production-ready AI product in 30 days. Ship real software that lasts and automate your backend architecture with Graph Engineering, Loop Engines, Contract Boundaries, and Runtime Gates. Lifetime access is live today for $29.

posts.name: LumaKeys
posts.tagline: Learn any piece from falling notes
posts.description: LumaKeys is a piano app for self-taught pianists that lets you learn any piece with falling notes instead of sheet music. Use the built-in transcription feature to turn any piano recording into MIDI and learn it in your way - by slowing down, looping, isolating hands or waiting for you to hit the notes. Record your own music, edit notes manually, create beautiful visualizations and export videos to level up your social media content. One place to organize your whole piano repertoire.

posts.name: gather: RSS News Reader
posts.tagline: RSS for iPhone and Android. No login, no unread guilt.
posts.description: An RSS reader for iPhone and Android with no login required. Two feeds: Browse for everything, Keep up for the few sources you never want to miss. Clean reader view, offline queue, and optional summaries that run on your device.

posts.name: Reanroom
posts.tagline: Every brand deal, link and payout in one place
posts.description: Reanroom is where UGC creators run the business side of content: a deal pipeline from inbound DM to paid invoice, affiliate links with click tracking, a live media kit, a link-in-bio page, and Content AI that turns one video into a week of posts.

posts.name: Keyban Agent Wallet
posts.tagline: Your AI agents pay. You stay in control.
posts.description: Agent Wallet gives AI agents their own account to pay, get paid and hold a balance autonomously — while keeping finance teams in control. Set budgets, spending limits, approved beneficiaries and payment rules. Every transaction is checked against company policies before execution, with full visibility and the ability to freeze or stop an agent at any time.

posts.name: Orbitae
posts.tagline: You remember the number. Do you remember who's behind it?
posts.description: Orbitae is the private way to track your dating history: who you've been with, how you rate them, and how they all connect.

posts.name: newdo
posts.tagline: The todo list where the list is an output, not an input
posts.description: Most todo apps make you maintain the list: fields, priorities, pruning. newdo inverts that. Type what you owe in plain words. It works out who it's for, when it's due and how big it is, then shows you the five things that matter today, each with a reason. Correct it in a sentence ("things from Arun are never urgent") and it writes a rule so the mistake never repeats. Local-first, no account, no AI model: dates, people and effort are inferred with rules, so it's instant and works offline.

posts.name: solm
posts.tagline: A task app that picks one thing for you.
posts.description: solm is the anti-backlog task app for busy minds. Instead of another endless list, it shows one thing — the single task that matters most right now, picked from your priorities and your current mode. It tells you what to do next.

posts.name: Quick.Surf
posts.tagline: Stop searching. Start surfing — all your links, one page.
posts.description: Quick.Surf turns messy browser bookmarks into one beautiful, lightning-fast personal page. Thousands of icons, alternative links, private & public sharing, daily backups — plus Chrome & Firefox extensions. Free to start.

posts.name: Pocket Logistics
posts.tagline: Warehouse & inventory control from your phone
posts.description: Pocket Logistics is a mobile-first warehouse and inventory management tool, built by a logistics operations professional tired of clunky, desktop-only systems. Calculate pallet fitting by volume/weight, run ABC (Pareto) analysis, track warehouse occupancy in real time, and monitor delivery status — all from your phone, no install needed. $29/month, 7-day free trial. Built for warehouse supervisors, inventory analysts, and small logistics teams who need answers on the floor.

posts.name: KeeperPass
posts.tagline: A password manager with no server. Nothing to breach.
posts.description: An open-source password manager with no server and no database. Your vault is one encrypted file in your own Google Drive — encrypted on your device, so the only thing Google receives is ciphertext it can't read. Argon2id + AES-256-GCM. One OAuth scope. Free forever, AGPL-3.0. Autofill, TOTP, password generator, multiple vaults. Nothing to breach, because there's nothing to hold.

posts.name: Varn - Product Variants and Swatches AI
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Product Variants & Swatches for Shopify
posts.description: Varn turns product options into color swatches and variant images across product pages, collections, search, and quick view. One click AI setup reads your catalog and fills in swatches, even when a name alone can't tell colors apart. No manual mapping, no theme rebuild, your theme still owns the add to cart button. It also scores each product on AI shopping assistant readiness, with a style studio to match swatch shape, size, and spacing to your brand, live preview included.

posts.description: Lerix puts error tracking, performance monitoring, analytics and push notifications behind one SDK. It ships with an MCP server, so your AI coding agent sees the real stack trace instead of guessing. Run it in our cloud or on your own servers.
